question: What is the name of the new generation ballistic missile with a range of 1,000-2,000 km that was successfully flight tested at APJ Abdul Kalam Island in April 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agni Prime**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Agni Prime** is a new generation advanced ballistic missile.
 
• It has a range capability of **1,000 to 2,000 kilometers**.
 
• The missile is a part of the **Agni series** developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) of India.
 
• The successful flight test was conducted at **APJ Abdul Kalam Island** in April 2024.
 
• Agni Prime features improved accuracy and advanced technologies compared to its predecessors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Agni Series Missiles**

 
 
• The Agni series includes various strategic ballistic missiles developed by DRDO.
 
• These missiles are designed to enhance India's nuclear deterrence capabilities.
 
• Other missiles in the series include Agni-I, Agni-II, Agni-III, Agni-IV, and Agni-V.
 
• Each missile in the Agni series has different range capabilities, varying from 700 km to over 5,000 km.
 
 
 
• **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**
 
 
• DRDO is an agency under the Department of Defence Research and Development in the Ministry of Defence, India.
 
• It is responsible for the development of technology for use by the military.
 
• DRDO's mission is to achieve self-reliance in critical defence technologies and systems.
 
 
 
• **APJ Abdul Kalam Island**
 
 
• Formerly known as Wheeler Island, it is located off the coast of Odisha, India.
 
• It is named after Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam, the 11th President of India and a renowned aerospace scientist.
 
• The island serves as a missile testing facility for DRDO.
 
 
 
• **Ballistic Missile**
 
 
• A ballistic missile follows a sub-orbital flight path to deliver its payload to a predetermined target.
 
• These missiles are categorized based on their range: short-range, medium-range, intermediate-range, and intercontinental.
 
• Ballistic missiles are capable of carrying conventional or nuclear warheads.
